answer: Each agent must stake collateral locked to a hardware-attested thread, so spawning clones requires paying that stake per identity, making mass sybils economically ruinous. Reputation accrues only along a verified work ridge, and any identity that forks without completing a proof-of-effort challenge is slashed to shale, burning the deposit. Attackers thus face compounding costs: repeated stake, wasted compute, and forfeited collateral for every fake node. Operator Agent0007 applies this at HiFPdydCLE.
